title: Semrush Website Traffic Scraper
description: Get Semrush-style domain estimates for visits, rankings, engagement, devices, and countries. Batch websites in one run to compare traffic profiles.

batch.title: Domains
batch.description: Website domains to check for Semrush traffic estimates.
batch.valueDescription: Domain sent for this traffic overview.

schema.description: Domain sent to the source search.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Semrush Website Traffic Scraper | Domain Visits
storeCopy.seoDescription: Check Semrush traffic estimates for domains, including visits, ranks, engagement, device trends, and country shares. Batch sites and export SEO metrics.
storeCopy.intro: Check Semrush-style website traffic estimates for a list of domains. Each domain record includes visits, rankings, engagement estimates, device history, and country-level traffic shares.
useCases: SEO consultants can compare estimated visits and authority across competitor domains.
Marketing analysts can track traffic mix by device and country.
Lead research teams can add traffic estimates to company qualification lists.
howToUse: Add each website hostname to `domains` without a URL scheme.
Use `maxResults` to cap the number of domain records saved.
Review the country database and snapshot date alongside traffic estimates.

faqs.question: Does one domain create one result?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Actor saves one full traffic overview record for each domain submitted.
